data.spec: POST /api/decpage: multipart {file: PDF | .txt | .eml} or JSON {text} → {policy: Policy, created: boolean, previousPremium?: number}. lib/decpage.ts parseDecPage({text?, pdf?:{data,filename}}) extracts insurer/kind/product/premium (normalized to monthly from 6/12-mo term)/renewsOn/memberSince/phone/facts/coverage via getModel('smart'), PDF passed as an AI SDK file part. Upserts by kind + insurer first word (auto-northstar stays auto-northstar), keeps existing coverage rules/requirements and facts the page doesn't mention. Identifiers (policy no, VIN, licence, DOB, street address) forced to disclosure 'hidden'. Then adds a signal and runs checkPolicy in the background. Errors: 400 bad input, 503 no model, 422 unreadable. UI: components/dec-page-upload.tsx (drop zone on home, redirects to /policy/[id]). Demo sample: data/sample-dec-page-northstar.txt (Northstar renewal $1,488/6mo = $248/mo, +18%).

data.note: Built route + parser + home drop zone + sample dec page. tsc/oxfmt clean, plumbing smoke-tested. Pending: live model run (no local env yet).
